name: Shovel
summary: The official store introduces the shovel as your starting tool for moving hay by hand and earning money before buying belts and machines.

data.operation: For a first-session plan, handle a small amount of hay, find the SELL HAY destination and follow the game’s interaction prompts. Keep needle searching separate from simply clearing the pile.
data.check: Before replacing manual work with automation, identify the slow step: collecting, carrying, selling or scanning. Buy for that bottleneck using your current in-game prices.
